career_spells.employer: Laxale's Hair & Beauty Supplies Pty Ltd
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the employer, combined titles and November 2004 to November 2017 boundaries. The secondary biography identifies it as the family hair-and-beauty supplies business. Ownership, remuneration, hours, leave and title transitions are unresolved, including overlap with party and elected roles. Follow-up: matching ABR entity identifies legal name and ABN 74 098 599 065; its 2001 registration is not the member’s employment commencement. Historical shareholding, actual hours and division between management work and directorship remain unknown. First-person1June2022 interview describes nearly20years in family business within a board-director narrative, differing from the recorded2004–2017 combined executive interval. This does not extend active management to2022; separate board versus employee terms require clarification.
career_spells.counting_note: A senior title in a family business does not prove self-employment or substantive full-time work.

career_spells.employer: Small business consultancy (legal entity and client names unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: First-person2022 campaign questionnaire says Laxale runs a small business consultancy separately from serving on boards. Original2018–19 council report independently describes current business-consultant activity. These are dated observations, not appointment/cessation boundaries. Consultancy entity, clients, payment, weekly hours, leave and overlap with family business/council/governance unknown. Self-employment is supported by operating a consultancy, without full-time inference. Matching public professional experience index supplies March2019–May2022 sole-trader consultancy boundaries, provisionally retained at month precision. Exact days, hours and campaign leave absent; separate GFTH company index attributes interest to spouse/partner, so it is not assigned as his employer.
career_spells.counting_note: Private commercial activity supported, but dates and substantive full-time hours absent; no headline duration or election cessation inferred.

career_spells.evidence_note: Member and party biographies corroborate ten years in local government; the secondary chronology supplies election and resignation dates. The final interval overlaps federal service because resignation from council followed the federal election. Official indexed biography instead gives June2022 cessation, conflicting with recorded22July2022 resignation. Retain supported existing exact date pending original council resignation resolution. Original City of Ryde2022–23 annual report,p126, expressly records resignation tendered22July2022; original23August2022 agenda likewise states he resigned22July. This directly corroborates the held day date over the conflicting APH June2022 entry.26July2022 meeting noted resignation; that meeting date is not substituted for cessation. The original council account supports council/House overlap without proving other paid work.
career_spells.counting_note: Local elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary chronology supplies the second mayoral term dates; member-controlled biographies describe five years as mayor in total. career_spells.role: Non-Executive Director and Risk Committee Chair
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen extract supplies the non-executive directorship and month boundaries; the secondary biography adds Risk Committee chair. StateCover describes itself as a mutual owned by its member councils. Remuneration and meeting load are unresolved, and non-executive governance is not treated as substantive employment. LGNSW report refines initial appointment to 10 September 2018, with reappointment 20 November 2019. Council ownership and nomination arrangements do not alone resolve the codebook’s ultimate-control test; prior private-control coding is therefore withheld. Scheduled November 2022 term is not used to replace recorded June 2022 departure.

Are earlier jobs or later business-consulting clients omitted from official occupations, and what are their dates and hours?
Can primary records refine Venture Café, party and local-government chronology and paid/unpaid conditions?
Which parliamentary office hosted the2004 ANU internship, on which exact dates, and with what remuneration, hours and study-credit arrangements?

What is the consultancy legal entity, exact commencement/cessation, clients, personal pay/hours and leave? Could GFTH Pty Ltd consultancy holding be linked through original declarations, and how does family-business governance extend beyond executive2017 endpoint?

Can original professional/employer records corroborate self-reported March2019–May2022 consultancy and July2018–September2021 Venture Cafe terms? research_notes: 2026-10-01 follow-up: official register resolves matching family company; historical LGP report reclassifies Associate Director as excluded governance, and LGNSW report refines StateCover appointment and establishes paid treasurer governance. No salary-to-hours conversion or external-board pay allocation made.

Searched family company, LGP historical annual reports, StateCover and LGNSW filings, first speech and declarations. LGP 2022 report corroborates board context; 2021/22 LGNSW website PDF failed retrieval, but 2020/21 FWC-hosted report was readable. Member speech page timed out; public Hansard reproduction describes parents’ long hours, not a dated work pattern for the member. Later StateCover membership resignation is not treated as his directorship cessation. No evidence of a calculable full-time family-business interval found.
Second follow-up2October2026 improves education and placement chronology; totals remain unknown.

Targeted family-business full-time searches yielded staff vacancies rather than personal hours, which were rejected. Council26June2018 agenda, printed pp49–50, reproduces Venture Cafe innovation partnership resolution but does not appoint Laxale personally to its board. PDF exceeded web-reader size limit; ordinary direct download and text extraction succeeded. Partnership funding/trial dates do not establish personal governance term. Next leads remain family payroll/hours, personal Venture Cafe appointment, internship host and original LGP appointment instruments.

Follow-up3October2026 resolves ANIP internship year to2004 through original university anniversary publication. Targeted Venture Cafe search yielded a commercial aggregator claiming30June2018, without an original appointment instrument, so no exact date adopted. Council partnership date was already examined and is not personal appointment evidence. Full-time search again found staff vacancies, not personal working hours. No headline years calculated; future needs are original internship host record, Venture Cafe board minutes and family payroll/work-pattern evidence.

Fourth follow-up4October2026 repeated exact ANIP2004 host-office, Venture Cafe Sydney board and family-business full-time searches. Results repeated the existing ANIP program attribution, organisation-level partnership and unrelated staff vacancies; no host, appointment instrument, personal payroll, hours or leave evidence emerged. Namesakes and organisation-level partnership material were excluded.

Follow-up2026-10-04: First-person2022 campaign answer and primary2018–19 council profile establish omitted consultancy work; separate unknown-date self-employed spell added. New1June2022 interview nearly20-year family-business wording is not substituted for2004–2017 executive interval; possible board continuation retained as gap.2025 local interview corroborates later consultancy. Public interests index GFTH Pty Ltd consultancy is only an original-register lead, not silently made payroll employer.2018–19 PDF reader content-size error and LGP2021 URL404 are source gaps; primary indexed profile and accessible personal testimony remain usable.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Targeted current primary professional profile supplies consultancy March2019–May2022 and Venture Cafe July2018–September2021 month boundaries; no full-time claim or precise days. Official indexed biography supplies separate Eastwood presidency2008–2016 and June2022 councillor cessation conflicting with held22July date. Family-interest transcription explicitly assigns GFTH holding/directorship to spouse/partner; original declaration remains required and no member-employer linkage adopted. Contact aggregators and rounded tenure calculations not used as evidence. Personal hours, family payroll and original appointment instruments remain priorities.

Second targeted pass2026-10-05 original Ryde2022–23 report,p126, and23August2022 council agenda expressly establish22July2022 resignation, resolving held secondary day date with primary corroboration despite APH June2022 conflict.26July meeting only notes resignation, not the end day. Council2August summary introduces second mayoral-term December2021 wording versus11January2022 successor election; retained as explicit transition gap without unsupported date replacement. Annual-report reader400 timeout and agenda/minutes403 are source-level; primary publicly indexed statements available.
